segments.text: Today we've got two brand new developer friendly Mac OS apps that solve real problems.
Mac USB. If you've ever tried to create a bootable Mac OS USB on an Apple Silicon Mac, you already know the pain.

headaches, no expired installer certificate errors. Just plug in a USB drive, select your Mac OS installer, and
Mac USB handles everything. If you repair Macs or just want a reliable way to revive legacy Intel machines, Mac usB is a must- have utility.
